description: This Java source file defines the EventBusAuthenticationService class, which implements an authentication service using Vert.x Event Bus to send authentication requests and handle responses. It includes nested classes for user representation and token validation. The class manages asynchronous communication, token expansion, and error handling related to authentication.

classes.name: EventBusAuthenticationService
classes.description: A final class implementing an authentication service that communicates via Vert.x Event Bus to perform user authentication based on JWT tokens.

classes.name: EventBusAuthenticationService.HonoUserImpl
classes.description: A nested static class representing an authenticated user with token parsing, expiration management, and authorities extraction.

methods.name: EventBusAuthenticationService.
methods.description: Constructor initializing the authentication service with Vert.x environment and token validator.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication by sending a request over Vert.x Event Bus and processing the response.

methods.name: HonoUserImpl.
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a JWT token and extracts user claims and authorities.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the subject (name) of the JWT token.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the authorities associated with the user.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired, considering a leeway period.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration time of the token.
